description: environment.removeCustomEnvironment omits the 404 the live API returns for a missing environment (code `not_found`, message "Environment not found." — live-verified 2026-08-13), so distilled's typed union lacks NotFound. The idempotent delete path catches the typed NotFound tag; without it the 404 surfaces as the catch-all. (Deleting by a still-existing id twice answers 200 both times; only an unknown slug/id 404s.)
